mutation Authenticate($credentials: Credentials!) {
    authenticate(credentials: $credentials) {
        result
        token
        reactivation
        contributor {
            id
            publicName
            firstName
            lastName
            email
            lastActive
            dateCreated
            status

}

        preferredLanguage
        graveBucks

        memorialUpdateEmails
        newMessageEmails
        siteUpdateEmails
        marketingEmails
        photoRequestEmails
        allowMessages
        theme
        groups
        bio

        }

            }
        }
        siteSponsor

}
